scientific_integrity: A complete inductive proof is supplied. Exact prime-field checks for n=3,4,5,6 corroborate but do not certify the infinite argument. No novelty or external certification is claimed beyond the bounded scientific comparisons described in the review.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem identifies rank and the full degree-at-most-two relation space for complete-graph labelled spanning trees; no nonzero Gram eigenvalue formula or quantitative conditioning is asserted. Earlier broad matroid-basis inclusion literature could potentially contain an equivalent theorem; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Quadratic Walsh uniqueness on the spanning-tree slice of a complete graph
